About Me

A problem solver behind the scenes

Hi, I'm Iheoma, an Executive Virtual Assistant with 5+ years experience and behind-the-scenes problem solver who genuinely enjoys bringing order to busy schedules, overflowing inboxes, and fast-moving teams.
